request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: Joins symbol_profile to file_profile to filter symbols in the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo package, excluding test files. It keeps only public symbols and counts top-level classes, top-level functions, and methods, grouping by kind. Nested functions and classes are excluded by requiring no enclosing class for class/function kinds.
sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbol_profile s JOIN code.file_profile f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.package = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo' AND s.in_test_file = false AND s.is_public AND ((s.kind = 'class' AND s.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NULL) OR (s.kind = 'function' AND s.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NULL) OR s.kind = 'method') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind
